answer.outline: The page renders products and a visible empty state when the collection is empty; ordinary untrusted values remain escaped in HTML templates.
suggested_steps: Pass data from the view instead of embedding it in the template.
Use a base template for shared layout and a child block for page content.
Do not use safe/Markup for untrusted values.
